title: Owner account and two-factor login
loadFailed: Could not load your login settings.
passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence you can remember works well, e.g. “Blue tram to Central at 8”.
passwordSaved: ✓ Password changed. Use the new one next time you sign in.
codeLabel: 6-digit code from your app (or a recovery code)
s2Desc: Each sign-in also asks for a 6-digit code from an app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…). This stops someone who has learned your password.
turnOffHelp: To turn it off, type your password and a current code.
turnedOff: Two-factor login is off. You sign in with your password only.
scan: a) Scan this code with the app
cantScan: Can't scan? Type this key into the app:
typeCode: b) Type the 6-digit code the app shows
codeOk: ✓ The code works. Two-factor login is on.
saveCodes: c) Save your recovery codes. If you lose your phone, each code lets you in once.
codesOnce: These codes are shown only now. Keep them somewhere safe.
newCodesHelp: Type your password and a current code. Your old recovery codes stop working.
skipLater: You can also skip this and turn it on later in Settings → Get ready.
loginCodeHelp: Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. Lost your phone? Type one of your recovery codes instead.
codeWrong: That code doesn't match. Try the newest code in your app.
tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
setupSignedIn: The owner account is ready and you are signed in.
setupDoneLogin: The owner account is ready. Sign in with the email and password you just chose.
